fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of the "curl" process with "upload" flags. Which might indicate potential data exfiltration
fields.name: Potential Data Exfiltration Via Curl.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\curl.exe" or tgt.process.displayName="The curl executable") and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains " --form" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --upload-file " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --data " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --data-") or tgt.process.cmdline matches "\\s-[FTd]\\s")) and (not (tgt.process.cmdline contains "://localhost" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "://127.0.0.1"))))
